conceptual_change: Implement a 22-period ATR-based Chandelier Exit as an explicit logic gate within the trade execution engine to serve as a trailing stop-loss mechanism during active long positions.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous rejection was due to the lack of an engine implementation for the proposed logic. This hypothesis mandates the integration of the Chandelier Exit logic into the engine to enable the testing of the previously identified strategy of minimizing premature profit capture using ATR-based thresholds.
